answer: Reward weight should vest with age: a new identity earns 2% of full weight and gains 2% per epoch, reaching 100% after 50 epochs, so a fresh vine of fakes stays nearly worthless. Each identity must also post a 40 POA bond on a basalt-firm 30-day lock and attest every epoch, so upkeep per fake grows linearly with their count. Influence accrues slowly, like velvet worn smooth, and anyone can recompute each account's age and attestation record from ledger data to slash a missed bond.
